bias.zh: 回升 · 收复 30 日均线，位于 5 日均线下方

read.en: Broadcom rose 2.5% on Nov 17 to $341.60, closing near the $341.74 high after a $330.13 low. It is above the 10-day ($329.4, rising) and 30-day ($337.5, falling), and below the 5-day ($346.3), 100-day ($364.0) and 200-day ($367.5). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram easing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($300.18), and RSI is 51.4.
read.zh: 博通 11月17日上涨 2.5%，收于 $341.60，盘中低见 $330.13 后收在 $341.74 高点附近。股价位于 10 日（$329.4，上行）和 30 日均线（$337.5，下行）上方，5 日（$346.3）、100 日（$364.0）和 200 日均线（$367.5）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图回落；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$300.18），RSI 为 51.4。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 30-day and the $337.7–338.6 resistance (Nov 13 low), now support. Resistance is $344.3–347 (Nov 11 low, 5-day, Nov 13 close), then $350.1–358.5 and $364–369.8 (100 and 200-day, Nov 12 high). Support is $337.5–337.7, then $327.8–330.1 (10-day, Nov 16 and 17 lows) and $316.7–319.5. A close above $347 would target $350–358.5; below $337.5, $328–330.
